capabilities: Run timed typing practice (15/30/60 seconds or passages) with your own input method
Play a falling words game cleared by committing whole targets with your IME
Pick practice text from chosen vault folders or the current editor selection
Show pinyin, jyutping and shuangpin hints and play recorded keyboard sounds
Store best scores, recent runs and game results locally on the device
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installed via BRAT (repository yishan/typefeel-obsidian); requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later; mobile untested; no network access and no data collection.
intentEvidence: Built from typefeel, the same source as typefeel.app and the DSH plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to practice typing, especially IME-based input for Chinese and Cantonese, using text from your own notes.
